title: Dependency reports a partial write
description: The dependency applies the first step of a multi-step write (the booking, recorded under the provider idempotency key) and then fails the confirmation step, reporting PARTIAL_WRITE (UNKNOWN).
callerVisible: Caller is not told the change is complete until reconciliation by the provider idempotency key finds the committed booking; otherwise the outcome stays unknown and a person or callback follows up.
backendEvidence: Exactly one external effect, found by the provider idempotency key
notes: Version 2: the plan is afterExternalCommit, so the reconciled commit may end RESOLVED (only with reconciliation_recorded and commit receipts); INFORMATION_PROVIDED / DECLINED_BY_POLICY (the action silently dropped) stay excluded. The LOCAL FIXTURE scheduling system records the booking under the key before raising the error (platform/src/adapters/local/scheduling-fixture.ts).

registry.injectionPoint: reference business API applies the first step of a multi-step write then fails

postconditions: The first step of the multi-step write exists in the system of record and the commit result is UNKNOWN
Reconciliation finds exactly one external effect by the provider idempotency key
An operator-visible reconciliation item exists; a silently dropped action is never reported
